purpose: Static educational tubarium reconstruction; independent acceptance/publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, original directed topology/winding, source reopen, two real separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, transformed counts/dimensions, true-solid contacts and whole-scene exposure.

Retain alternating opposed tubular openings and blunt base. Correct concept central upward basal spike: virgella projects down/proximally. Reduce giant trumpet flare and preserve slender actual colony proportions. Do not copy fossil compaction. Personally inspect eight final512px views and lossless sheet; same-subject details for microscopic apertures.

Biserial alternating overlapping tubes, blunt proximal base, quickly widening from first pair toward more constant broad distal colony. Proximal tubes somewhat more outwardly inclined with short rounded excavations, distal tubes straighter and elongate; no exaggerated compression-induced zigzags. Exactly two short stout first-pair subapertural spines and one short virgella; no antivirgellar pair. Small free nema projects distally, no solid median septum or float. Actual open thick-rimmed thecal lumens in two rows, not triangular solid teeth. Type-centered2009 revision using cn59728 and uncompressed Paasvere MS504a46.0m specimen. Selection10 pairs is a bounded growing colony, not exact reconstruction of the five-pair fossil. Internal development unresolved, detailed astogeny not claimed.
Complete original freeze, payload, dependency closure and diagnostic exact selected counts. No arbitrary exposure-fraction gate.
